description: The main window. The app's own commands read and write named files in the app's data folder (tracks, the piece library, the autosave), and write_export writes an exported track into the folder the user picked. dialog:allow-open is the Export folder picker; dialog:allow-message is the save prompt on close; core:window:allow-minimize / allow-toggle-maximize / allow-is-maximized / allow-close / allow-start-dragging / allow-internal-toggle-maximize are the page's own title bar (app/titlebar.js; the Windows frame is off), whose X still reaches the one close handler; core:window:allow-destroy lets the close handler (which flushes or clears the autosave) finish closing the window; core:window:allow-set-cursor-position lets a released drag handle put the cursor back where it was grabbed (app/core/handles.js).
